problem_text:
A logistics company must coordinate 8 delivery trucks to complete 8 different routes.

Each route consists of a sequence of checkpoint stops represented as pairs (Checkpoint, Service time),
where each pair specifies the checkpoint where the truck must stop and the amount of time required for service.
The order of pairs indicates the required sequence in which the checkpoint services must be performed.

Route details:
* R1 requires the sequence: (C3, 6) → (C6, 7) → (C1, 7) → (C8, 9) → (C4, 3) → (C2, 9) → (C5, 10) → (C7, 3)
* R2 requires the sequence: (C1, 7) → (C3, 2) → (C5, 2) → (C4, 9) → (C6, 7) → (C8, 2) → (C2, 9) → (C7, 8)
* R3 requires the sequence: (C3, 2) → (C1, 9) → (C2, 4) → (C6, 9) → (C5, 4) → (C7, 4) → (C4, 8) → (C8, 2)
* R4 requires the sequence: (C4, 10) → (C7, 7) → (C1, 5) → (C5, 8) → (C2, 10) → (C3, 1) → (C6, 6) → (C8, 6)
* R5 requires the sequence: (C4, 1) → (C6, 3) → (C7, 4) → (C1, 8) → (C2, 8) → (C8, 2) → (C5, 10) → (C3, 5)
* R6 requires the sequence: (C5, 6) → (C4, 10) → (C3, 10) → (C6, 2) → (C1, 4) → (C8, 3) → (C7, 7) → (C2, 4)
* R7 requires the sequence: (C1, 9) → (C4, 6) → (C3, 6) → (C2, 2) → (C6, 6) → (C7, 4) → (C8, 4) → (C5, 5)
* R8 requires the sequence: (C7, 2) → (C6, 5) → (C8, 3) → (C4, 9) → (C5, 4) → (C1, 10) → (C3, 8) → (C2, 6)

Each checkpoint service must run continuously once it begins and cannot be interrupted,
and each checkpoint can only service one truck at a time.
The objective is to determine the service schedule for all trucks at the checkpoints
so that the total completion time for all routes is minimized.
